title: Raising a dam sixteen feet
text: The Army Corps of Engineers raised both the main and auxiliary dams at Lake Isabella by 16 feet. A seepage problem was found in the auxiliary dam on April 28, 2006, and the lake was held 20 feet below its normal full level. The work also added a new 28-foot-high labyrinth weir, and it targeted three failure risks: overtopping, seepage, and earthquake damage. The safety improvements were substantially completed in November 2022.
